status: authored 2026-10-02; generated by tools/spectrier_cap.py into build/datapacks/cobblers_spectrier_cap. NOT RUN in any world: nothing here has been seen to tag, grant or remove anything.
spec: data/adopted_legendary_sites.json adopted_crown_cemetery.spectrier_once_per_player (the owner's decision, 2026-10-02: one Spectrier per player, permanently). This file carries the parameters the generator needs; the design and its weak points live in the spec.

site.centre_source: relayed from the spec's mechanism text. Horizontally it is the footprint centre of data/placements.json legendary_crown_cemetery (corner 4118, 1982, size 45 x 24 x 47 -> 4140.5, 2005.5); y112 is three above the paste's floor y109. tools/spectrier_cap.py fails closed if the centre leaves that footprint.
site.coverage_note: spawn radius 40 about y112 (raised from the builder's 32 by the main session, 2026-10-02) covers every column of the 45 x 47 footprint: the extreme corners are 32.5 horizontally and under 35 with the template's 24-block height. No Spectrier spawns naturally (Cobbleverse's spectrier label is weight 0), so a wild one this close was summoned here.

radii.player_near_why: the tick does nothing unless a player is this close to the centre: one selector a tick otherwise
radii.spawn_why: a wild Spectrier this close to the centre is one the cemetery summoned
radii.summoner_why: the nearest player this close to the new Spectrier is its summoner (the spec's accepted weak point: in a group, stand back or summon alone)

advancement_why: per player and permanent: an advancement with one minecraft:impossible criterion, granted only by command. The same shape as tools/legendaries.py's legendary/<id>/met; this id is not one of those (legendaries.py writes legendary/<encounter>/met, and data/legendaries.json has no Spectrier).

wild_test.what: an entity counts as a newly summoned wild Spectrier only if ALL of these hold; anything else near the cemetery is tagged `skip` the first time it is inspected and never looked at again
wild_test.species_source: Cobblemon 1.8.0 util/codec/internal/PokemonP1.kt:92 (Species.BY_IDENTIFIER_CODEC.fieldOf(DataKeys.POKEMON_SPECIES_IDENTIFIER)); util/DataKeys.kt:12 POKEMON = "Pokemon", :14 POKEMON_SPECIES_IDENTIFIER = "Species"; PokemonEntity.kt:920 writes the compound under "Pokemon". https://gitlab.com/cable-mc/cobblemon/-/tree/1.8.0
wild_test.wild_source: Cobblemon 1.8.0 PokemonP3.kt:92 writes PokemonOriginalTrainerType with optionalFieldOfWithDefault(..., NONE), which ALWAYS writes the value (util/codec/ExpressionCodec.kt:35-39 maps every value to Optional.of); Pokemon.kt:526 defaults it to NONE; api/storage/party/PlayerPartyStore.kt:61-63 sets it to PLAYER on every Pokemon added to a player's party that has none. So a Pokemon a player has ever held reads PLAYER, and one nobody has held reads NONE.
wild_test.owner_source: Cobblemon 1.8.0 Pokemon.kt:879 sets the entity's ownerUUID to the owning store's UUID on every animated send-out (players and NPC trainers alike); PokemonEntity.kt:190 extends ShoulderRidingEntity, i.e. vanilla TamableAnimal, which saves a non-null owner as the top-level int-array "Owner". The vanilla half is NOT read from source here (Minecraft 1.21.1 is not in this repository); it is the belt to the OT braces, and the runtime check below confirms it.
wild_test.pastured: a pastured Pokemon's entity carries a Tethering compound INSTEAD of Pokemon (PokemonEntity.kt:907-921), so it never matches the species test and is skipped
wild_test.not_used: Pokemon.PokemonOwnerId: in 1.8.0 that key is written only inside Tethering (PokemonEntity.kt:913), never inside Pokemon. A filter on Pokemon.PokemonOwnerId never matches anything.

unattributed_why: the spec names the nearest player within 16 as the summoner and is silent when there is none. Read here (datapack-content-dev, 2026-10-02; the owner may change it): a wild Spectrier with nobody within 16 is left untagged and re-examined every tick, so it is attributed to the first player who comes within 16. Tagging it unattributed would let a capped player summon and step back 17 blocks.
summoner_excludes_spectators_why: an operator watching in spectator mode is never anyone's summoner

removal.method: teleport below the world, then kill
removal.why: a plain kill drops whatever a fainted wild Pokemon drops at the cemetery; killed 64 blocks under the world's floor, anything it drops falls into the void. tools/legendaries.py's keeper uses a plain kill for its duplicates; this one must not leave a reward behind.

refusal_message.text: The Spectrier looks at you, and is gone. It has answered you once already.

cross_system: tools/size_outliers.py (cobblers_sizes) gives a wild Spectrier its size roll like any wild Pokemon; nothing here reads or writes Pokemon.ScaleModifier
tools/blackout_pack.py tests a wild victor with the same Pokemon.PokemonOriginalTrainerType "NONE" filter; a removed Spectrier is gone within the tick it appeared, before any battle
tools/legendaries.py owns the rest of cobblers:legendary/*; this pack adds one advancement beside them and touches none of theirs
the pack writes no blocks and installs world-local (tools/reapply.py WORLD_LOCAL), self-driving through its own minecraft tick tag (EXCLUDED with that reason, contract C7)
